leadText:
Volume 27: Awakening of the Millennium is the 27th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second of four volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

The volume was also given a limited edition release to celebrate the series' ten year anniversary. This version contains a piece of artwork of the first ten Pokédex holders and their first Pokémon.

Volume 27: Awakening of the Millennium is the 27th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second of four volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

The volume was also given a limited edition release to celebrate the series' ten year anniversary. This version contains a piece of artwork of the first ten Pokédex holders and their first Pokémon. 

==Blurb==
When a mysterious armored villain in search of the Wish Pokémon Jirachi attacks Noland, Emerald is the prime suspect! Jirachi grants wishes, but only awakens every one thousand years for seven days. How can Emerald and the Frontier Brains prevent Jirachi’s power from falling into the wrong hands?!
